pages.title: Open It
pages.text: Press your **Horse Whistle** key while mounted to open a full profile of the horse you're riding. Pressing it without a horse still whistles your nearby mount.

pages.title: What's Shown
pages.text:
- **Gender** and **Breed** (with a **(mix)** tag if cross-bred).
- **Coat** - color plus markings.
- **Bond** - value out of 100 with a fill bar.
- **Speed** - blocks per second.
- **Jump** - block height.
- **Health** - hit points.

pages.title: Reading the Bars
pages.text:
Each bar fills toward the mod's maximum at full bond:

- Speed up to **25.5 blk/s**.
- Jump up to **9.5 blk**.
- Health up to **30 HP**.

A short bar means room to grow; bonding closes the gap.
